FR-002.title: Event sheet lists members active as of the event date, past or future

context: constraint: Events never generate financial records (events living spec)
constraint: printed reports hand off to the OS default viewer via a temp file, never an in-app viewer (reports-pipeline living spec)
constraint: PDF checkboxes render as a bordered box + checkmark glyph, never a solid filled box (CLAUDE.md)
intent: Let users print attendance/participation sheets for events and AGMs, blank ahead of time or reflecting real recorded data afterward, in the same format as the existing rehearsal attendance roll
expectations: No new 'scheduled future AGM' entity is introduced — a forward-looking AGM sheet is just a future Event of type Annual General Meeting
No spreadsheet/CSV export for either sheet — print/PDF only
No changes to how participation or AGM attendance is recorded — this feature only reads existing data
approach: Follow spec 012's rehearsal-attendance-roll precedent exactly: one read-only Core service+DTO pair per owning module (Events, Agm) assembling a printable checkbox roster, and QuestPDF renderers in StageFright.Reports that hand off to the OS default viewer. The two new renderers share one internal two-column layout helper (CheckboxSheetPdfBuilder) so the event sheet and AGM sheet stay visually identical, without creating any Core-to-Core module coupling or touching the generic IReportProvider pipeline.

decisions.decision: Bypass the generic IReportProvider/ReportData/PdfReportRenderer pipeline; reuse spec 012s bespoke-renderer escape hatch instead
decisions.why: ReportData is a flat single-table string-cell model with no multi-column/checkbox-glyph support, and printed reports must never gain shared-renderer complexity that all ten existing MVP reports would inherit
decisions.rejected: Extending ReportData/PdfReportRenderer with a checkbox-column concept, or registering these as IReportProviders in the generic Reports menu

decisions.decision: Two independent DTO/service pairs, one per owning module (Events, Agm), rather than one shared cross-module model
decisions.why: Constitution SS4.1 forbids a module importing another modules concrete folder, and no neutral shared-DTO location exists in this codebase; the two data sources also differ in shape (live recompute vs fixed historical snapshot)
decisions.rejected: A single shared AttendanceSheetData DTO in a new StageFright.Core/Shared/ folder

decisions.decision: Share the QuestPDF two-column/checkbox-cell page-layout mechanics via one new internal CheckboxSheetPdfBuilder in StageFright.Reports, used by both new renderers; leave AttendanceRollPdfRenderer untouched
decisions.why: User Story 3 requires the event sheet and AGM sheet to render identically; one shared implementation guarantees that where two hand-copies could drift, and StageFright.Reports is a downstream layer so sharing there creates no Core-to-Core module coupling
decisions.rejected: Duplicating the ~90-line layout twice, or refactoring the existing two-checkbox-column AttendanceRollPdfRenderer to also use the new one-checkbox-column builder

plan.summary: Plan complete: 2 new Core service/DTO slices (Events, Agm), 2 new QuestPDF renderers plus 1 shared internal layout helper in StageFright.Reports, 4 UI page extensions, 4 DI registrations - no schema changes, no IReportProvider registration.
plan.key_finding: Every read this feature needs already exists on current repositories (IEventRepository.GetByIdWithDetailsAsync, IMemberRepository.GetActiveAsOfAsync, IAgmAttendanceRepository.GetByAgmAsync) so no new repository method is required anywhere.

tasks.summary: 37 tasks across Setup, Foundational (shared CheckboxSheetPdfBuilder), US1 Events sheet (P1), US2 AGM report (P2), US3 layout-consistency verification (P3), and Polish.
